priorities.summary: Unrestricted upload of files with dangerous types in Tegsoft Contact Center allows an attacker to upload a web shell to the web server and take it over. The issue affects versions before latest-202611161510.
priorities.plain: Tegsoft Contact Center lets attackers upload a web shell and take over the server — update to the latest release.

priorities.summary: MONAI Label through 0.8.5 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint. It has been exploited in the wild since September 2026.
priorities.plain: MONAI Label lets attackers run code on the server and is already being exploited — upgrade past 0.8.5 now.

priorities.summary: Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an incomplete blocklist fix that allows attackers who can author entry type title formats to write arbitrary files using ZipArchive or XMLWriter classes, achieving remote code execution.
priorities.plain: Craft CMS lets a user who can edit content write files and take over the site — upgrade to 5.11.4.

model.name: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini
model.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on 20 November 2026, an open-weights multimodal model whose middle layers loop at inference time, squeezing stronger reasoning out of only 3.4B active parameters — small enough to run on a laptop. It is a research release, not tuned for production use.
model.plain: A capable open AI model that runs on ordinary business laptops, so teams can experiment and build with it without paying for cloud compute.
